name: element.at_invoke
description: Compound: element.at + element.invoke in one round-trip. Hit-test at coordinates, then invoke the element under the cursor.

x-output-schema.description: Empty body — wire response is the literal `OK 0`. Failures of either step surface as the relevant ERR.

x-implementations.name: uia_at_then_invoke
x-implementations.description: Internal: element.at (ElementFromPoint) followed by element.invoke (InvokePattern.Invoke). The intermediate elt:N id is allocated and discarded.

x-implementations.name: msaa_iaccessible
x-implementations.description: MSAA `AccessibleObjectFromPoint`, then `accDoDefaultAction` on the hit element.

windows-modern.description: ElementFromPoint + InvokePattern.Invoke. Differs from `input.mouse.click` at the same coords in two ways: (1) bypasses the foreground window and synthetic input — the invoke runs on the UIA pattern directly; (2) reaches some elements `input.mouse.click` can't (occluded under transparent layers, etc.).

windows-classic.description: Hit-test as `element.at`, then the default action as `element.invoke`. Shared MSAA rules (roles, tree shape, hidden elements, hung windows, handle limits): PROTOCOL.md §10.7.
